falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes more than 4% above its level at the start of the 14-day window and sets a new 52-week high, while the VIX closes below 13 on at least three sessions
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The tape resolved into a confirmed upside breakout, not an unresolved mini-top analog. UNKNOWN/HOLD would be wrong because the phase was bullish continuation and staying flat missed a clear risk-on move.

falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 falls more than 6% within 14 days and US high-yield OAS widens by at least 75 basis points versus the start of the window
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The decline exceeded a June-2019-style mini-top and was confirmed by credit stress. UNKNOWN/HOLD would be wrong because the correct call was risk-off, not an indeterminate hold.

falsification_conditions.condition: Nasdaq-100 gains more than 7% in 14 days while the VIX term structure stays in contango (VIX below VIX3M) every session and the 10-year Treasury yield rises by less than 15 basis points
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Price action is a low-vol melt-up, inconsistent with a 76% mini-top match and a middling blowoff score of 55. The unknown phase would be falsified as blowoff continuation, so HOLD was the wrong posture.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
